## 怎么验证的 / How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run check`（oxlint 无警告 + 单元测试 + 构建 / lint with no warnings + unit tests + build）
- [ ] `npm run e2e`（或相关场景 / or the relevant scenarios: `npm run e2e -- <name>`）
- [ ] 手动试过 / Tried by hand: <!-- 浏览器、语言、手机 / 桌面 / browser, language, mobile / desktop -->

## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] 界面文字同时加了 `zh.ts` 与 `en.ts` / UI strings added to both `zh.ts` and `en.ts`
- [ ] 行为改动附带了测试 / Behaviour changes come with tests
- [ ] 新曲目都是原创或公有领域，PR 里写明了来源 / New songs are original or public domain, with sources stated above
- [ ] 提交信息使用约定式前缀 / Commit messages use conventional prefixes (`feat(模块): …`, `fix: …`)
